why: Fact lineage has two different jobs: quote-readiness and migration audit. Active tenant intake is the quote-readiness population. Legacy standardized packs are useful for migration comparison, but they are not active truth and must not create quote-blocking conflicts by default.

active.statement: Current governed tenant intake files. These are the only default population for deciding whether a number is quotable.

std.statement: Legacy standardized/demo pack files. These can reveal migration drift, but are not active quote-readiness facts unless explicitly promoted through the active intake registry.

quote.purpose: Default mode. Use before quoting a metric in product copy, QA, or a client-facing narrative.

migration-audit.purpose: Optional mode. Use to find drift between active intake and legacy standardized packs.
